summary: Build donor-ready proposals, budgets, and logframes in 5 days. Learn practical methods to improve funding success and compliance.
lede: Grant and proposal writing for donors helps you connect organizational priorities, evidence, implementation plans, and donor requirements in one coherent submission. You will learn to assess needs, map donors, structure proposals, develop credible budgets, design logframes, and plan monitoring and evaluation. The course turns scattered drafting into a repeatable process for producing consistent, review-ready applications. Through practical exercises, you will work on concept notes, donor matrices, budget justifications, proposal outlines, compliance checks, submission templates, tracking workflows, and AI-assisted donor opportunity scanning.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is built for professionals who already work with donor funding, proposal development, or project design and need sharper execution tools. It suits people who must move from drafting isolated sections to managing a full donor submission process with greater precision.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in project design, programme delivery, fundraising, partnerships, or grant administration. Prior exposure to donor guidelines, basic budgeting, and results frameworks such as the logical framework approach is helpful, and no coding is required. For the digital workflow exercises, you should bring a laptop and be ready to work with spreadsheet-based budget templates, proposal matrices, and donor tracking tools.
